cells.gaps: No source states whether regulations under Loi n°025/2023 are issued or not. The only count of authority activity (GAB-002) gives no year or period, so it is activity, and no dated event in the twelve months to 2026-09-30 shows the law advancing or regressing.
cells.note: Standing is in-force and the Citibank sanction of 25 April 2024 (GAB-012) is a named, dated decision inside 36 months, so stage 4, with the authority constituted so no cap. Not stage 5: no published count for a stated year and no issued regulations.
